pins.name: VCC
pins.notes: 3.2 to 5.5 V. Draws about 100 mA when sending at full power

pins.name: RXD
pins.notes: UART: the part receives data here. Connect to an ESP32 TX pin (9600 baud by default)

pins.name: TXD
pins.notes: UART: the part sends data here. Connect to an ESP32 RX pin

pins.name: SET
pins.notes: LOW = AT command mode. Leave HIGH (internal pull-up) for normal use

pins.name: ANT
pins.notes: Antenna: spring antenna or u.FL connector

sources.title: HC-12 wireless serial port communication module user manual
sources.section: Pins VCC, GND, RXD, TXD, SET; 433.4 to 473.0 MHz; 9600 baud default; supply 3.2 to 5.5 V
